description: This file defines build rules and image configurations for Netgear devices in an OpenWRT build system. It includes build steps for creating root filesystem images, squashfs images, and device-specific image configurations.

methods.name: Build/netgear-rootfs
methods.description: Defines the build process for Netgear root filesystem images using mkimage and concatenation commands.

methods.name: Build/netgear-squashfs
methods.description: Defines the build process for creating a SquashFS image for Netgear devices, including compression and image preparation steps.

methods.name: Device/netgear_generic
methods.description: Specifies device-specific build variables, including kernel image processing, image targeting, and image composition steps.
